name: Mystery
description: Declarative mystery preset. Fair-play inquiry; no living-author imitation.
purpose: Offer a solvable puzzle with planted clues, red herrings, and a motivated solution.
writing_goals: Define the crime, the question, and the investigator's method
Plant fair clues before the reveal
Make the solution rearrange known facts, not invent new ones
constraints: Do not imitate a living author
Use abstract narrative style, not a named living voice
Clues introduced in the last chapter
A culprit with no access, motive, or opportunity
A detective who knows more than the reader without a stated reason
checklist: Timeline of the crime can be reconstructed
Every major clue appears before the accusation
Means, motive, and opportunity survive review
Red herrings are explained, not abandoned

pacing_tendency.value: interview and discovery pulses; withhold the answer, not the evidence

description_tendency.value: clue-bearing interiors, physical traces, and social rooms

dialogue_tendency.value: questions with agendas; testimony that conceals by selection
